artists.source_line: Welcome to the KIZZ ESSENCE ALL IN ONE BEDBURG 2027!🎉

features.rationale: The event is titled All-in-One and the main hotel where dancers are invited to stay is the same Landhaus Danielshof venue.
A recommended alternative hotel, Hotel Gut Hohenholz, is listed for attendees.
A dress code section is included with a dress code heading and day entries.
